confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors use recent aggregated Medellín prices as a proxy for the July 2026 window. Cocktail and wine prices are approximate estimates based on their relationship to local draft beer. Accommodation prices are holistic estimates and less certain.
comparable_city_reasoning: Food and drink estimates use Medellín-specific price aggregates; accommodation is estimated from Medellín's urban visitor market without a proxy city.
